LESSON: WRITING 7.4.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PUNCTUATION- • COMMAS • DOUBLE QUOTATION MARKS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Writing 7.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation- • Commas • Double Quotation Marks
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 7.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation- • Commas • Double Quotation Marks, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Which Punctuation marks do you know? 2. Why do we punctuate sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 7.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation- • Commas • Double Quotation Marks together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Writing clearly as learners use the comma to show pauses between words, phrases or clauses.

• Learning to Learn: Self-discipline as learner explores the internet sources on the use of the comma and the double punctuation marks

Values:
Love: Sharing as learners display posters or charts with sentences using the double quotation marks.

Link to other Subjects:

Learners are able to relate the concept of correct use of punctuation marks to their learning in all other subjects.
